capabilities: chat with Claude Messages API or OpenAI-compatible providers in streaming sessions
inspect vault notes, folders, metadata, links, and recent notes via read-only tools
create, append, update, and edit notes after explicit user approval
transcribe voice input through OpenAI-compatible, Deepgram, or DashScope speech-to-text
run optional read-only web search through Tavily or Brave Search
extras: Early MVP installed from source; not yet listed in the community plugin store. Free with bring-your-own-key; no hosted model credits or subscription. Delete and note rename are not exposed, and vault content is only sent to the chat provider when a vault tool result is needed.
motivation: The author built it to give one assistant experience across phones, tablets, and computers while treating the vault as the user's own data.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI assistant, and existing options are not designed to work consistently on mobile and desktop with user-supplied provider keys.

summary: Mobile-first AI assistant that chats with Claude or OpenAI-compatible providers, answers vault questions, and edits notes after approval.
